status: FROZEN before any Agent Memory score of an adapted profile was produced or inspected
evidence_classification: ADAPTED EXTERNAL EVIDENCE (not the upstream LongMemEval score; not independent validation of Agent Memory doctrine; does not replace canonical LongMemEval_S)

files.README.md: haystack_dates: 'a list of the timestamps of the history sessions'; question_date: 'the date of the question'; 'you may directly feed the timestamped history to your own chat system'

data/custom_history/sample_haystack_and_.reading: session dates are generator-assigned simulated occurrence times of each history session; evidence-session dates come from the question's designed timeline (e.g. knowledge_update fact_1_date/fact_2_date), filler dates are sampled around them, and every date receives a random same-day time

timestamp_field_inventory.scope: one per haystack session, aligned with haystack_session_ids[i] and haystack_sessions[i]
timestamp_field_inventory.maps_to_observed_at: YES (session-level observation anchor of every user turn in that session)

timestamp_field_inventory.attached_to: question (query time), not to any memory
timestamp_field_inventory.maps_to_observed_at: NO (it is the time of asking, not of any observation); used only as recall reference_time in the separately labelled diagnostic profile P2
NO: messages carry no timestamp; has_answer is a gold label and is never read by the adapter
NO (gold; never passed to Agent Memory)
NO (identifier; the 'answer_' prefix is gold-bearing and never reaches Agent Memory)

source_checks.order_inversion_note: sessions are ordered by day; the random same-day time makes within-day list order non-chronological, so canonical transaction (ingestion) order differs from source time order in 211 questions

mapping.source_field: haystack_dates[i] of the session containing the ingested item

applies_to.turn_plane: each user turn of the session (all turns share the session timestamp)

mapping.timezone: the source carries no zone; values are declared as UTC by convention for every item. Only relative order and day-scale windows are exercised; absolute zone is unknown and not claimed
mapping.missing_or_invalid: an unparseable date declares no observed_at for that item (counted as unmapped); no fallback, no inference from order, gold, or question

C.name: canonical
C.role: canonical LongMemEval_S at the runtime base; kept intact

P1.name: source-anchored
P1.role: PRIMARY adapted profile: differs from C only by observed_at

P2.name: source-anchored + question reference time
P2.role: DIAGNOSTIC adapted profile: P1 plus recall reference_time = question_date. Separately labelled because it changes two inputs; pre-registered here because without a recall reference instant the runtime labels every interpreted window 'no_reference_time', so P1 cannot exercise interpreted self-validity demotion at all

pre_registered_hazards: latest_gold_ranked_first defines 'latest' by the same haystack_dates that P1/P2 declare as observed_at; any change in that metric under P1/P2 is partly endogenous and must be attributed to the ordering stage that used the clock

P1/P2 replace transaction_time with declared_observed_at as the ordering clock in temporal_order_within_query_regime (a BM25-tie stage under ordering intents); this is a declared-clock tiebreak mechanism distinct from interpreted self-validity

P2: 76 questions have sessions dated after question_date (1,475 session items / 7,525 turn items, including 66 / 67 gold items), an artifact of the upstream compiler; interpreted windows anchored at such sessions can read as not-yet-applicable at the question's reference time
tuning_rule: this mapping is not revised after Agent Memory metrics are observed
